family history of premature heart disease.
In addition the new guidelines identify four groups of subjects who should be considered for 
statin treatment:
1. Individuals with clinical ASCVD
2. Individuals with primary elevations of LDL-C >190 mg/dl
3. Individuals with diabetes, aged 40–75 years, with LDL-C 70–189 mg/dL
4. Individuals without ASCVD or diabetes, with LDL-C 70–189 mg/dL, and estimated 10-year 
ASCVD risk of ≥7.5%.
